title: Exercise the FX conversion contract
instruction: Write thorough node:test tests for src/fx.js, adding them under test/. Do not change production code. Cover conversion between non-USD currencies, cent rounding, zero and same-currency conversions, quote shape, constructor validation of rates, unknown currencies and invalid amounts. FxTable rates are units per USD; constructor takes a snapshot, conversion rounds the final result to cents, negative/nonfinite amounts are rejected, and rates must be positive finite numbers. The current implementation is the contract; the existing test is only a smoke test.
